text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, and decision-making. Machine learning is a key part of AI. It allows computers to learn from data and improve over time without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks to handle complex tasks like image and speech recognition. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask voice assistants questions, get movie recommendations, or use translation apps. AI is changing the way we live and work.
